steps: An unexpected meeting with Chitose on the street leads to a conversation about the training of "Jinken Hitotsu"...
The reunion with Chitose was an unexpected one.
... As I suspected. Simply by waiting here, I would see you again.
Ah, Chitose! Long time no see!
You waited here just for me? Is something the matter?
My ==SEX11==... If I may speak plainly, this time I came to you because ...==W== I have a request to make.
Yes. Until now, I have remained steadfast in my training, ever honing myself as the blade that protects you.
What I seek is none other than the state of "Jinken Hitotsu."
"Jinken Hitotsu"? I don't want to sound dumb, but could you explain?
It means that the blade can sense its wielder's thoughts and feelings from afar and act of its own accord without needing commands. Such is the ideal I pursue.
I see, so that's what you meant.
You want me to train with you so you can achieve this "oneness between blade and wielder"?
As one might have expected, my ==SEX11==, you have seen through my intention. You already understand the true meaning of "Jinken Hitotsu."
Huh? No, I just ... kind of guessed—
I wish to experience your state of Oneness—here and now, if possible! I hope to grasp its true essence as soon humanly possible.
That's some intense admiration... But setting that aside for now, this whole "Jinken Hitotsu" thing... This is the first I've heard of it...
Is it that ... in your eyes, I'm still not ready to grasp that Oneness?
Ugh... It's all my fault... I'm simply not worthy... I've let you down, and I'm truly ashamed...!
Wait, wait! Don't just jump to conclusions and immediately start blaming yourself—!
Anyway—I think it's going to be fine! Chitose, I know you'll definitely be able to master "Jinken Hitotsu."
Of course. After all, I—ahem ...==W== I'm speaking as someone who has already mastered Oneness!
She always seems a little lost whenever she's in a crowd.
Is there anything you're interested in seeing?
Very well. Even if I tried to hide it, you'd see right through me, my ==SEX11==, since you've already mastered "Jinken Hitotsu."
Sorry to let you down, but there's no "see right through" going on here!
As you know, I am an "unsheathed blade." Thus I'm always worried I might accidentally harm someone merely passing by.
Now that she mentions it, that's actually true. For some reason, I seem to be the only one who can touch Chitose without getting hurt...
So you're still having trouble controlling your body's magic blade?
I-I'm terribly sorry... It's all because my training is still lacking...
I have no choice but to break my own blade as an apology!
Wait! That was just a throwaway question!
My ==SEX11==...! You are always so kind and forgiving. I am ... truly unworthy!
Whew... Hearing Chitose talk about "breaking her own blade" is way too scary. That's not something to joke about...
Anyway, if you're worried about there being too many people around...
You can come a little closer to me. This way, you definitely won't hurt anyone else.
You wish for me ... to come closer to you, my ==SEX11==...?
What's with that reaction?! Did you misunderstand me?!
No, my ==SEX11==, this too is part of the training to attain Oneness between wielder and blade. I understand completely...!
Is it what you believe? Oh well, never mind. Let's just hold each other's—
Then... If you will pardon my boldness—
She hugged me so tight all the sudden!!!
What do you mean, "how does it feel"?! What are you even doing right now?! Hey, hey—are you listening?!
I am your blade, my ==SEX11==; and a blade rightfully belongs at its ==SEX11=='s side.
That's why I am attempting to have you "sheathe your blade"...!
Ah... That look on your face... Could it be that I've misunderstood your command?
No... It's not your fault. I'm the one who said we could get close. Anyway, it's not so much that you misunderstood…
Have I failed to understand your intention, my ==SEX11==...? So much for attaining Oneness between wielder and blade. Have I already failed...?
There is no hope for me...! Now I have no choice but to break my own blade—
No, I can't let myself get swept up in her way of thinking... I need to figure out how to steer the conversation…
Chitose, if you want to master Oneness, how about trying a different approach?
Do you mean a test cut? I am prepared.==W== Please instruct me. What would you have me cut?
So, we're going to a shop. I want you to try guessing what I'm planning to buy. Simple enough, right?
So I am to guess what you wish to buy... I see.
As you wish, my ==SEX11==. I will not fail you.
And so, with Chitose clinging tightly to my waist, we walk into the blacksmith's shop.
Welcome! Looking for a particular blade? Our shop's wares are unmatched for miles around!
Is this ... a blacksmith's shop...? Ahhh...
My ==SEX11==... Is it because I lost composure earlier...? Are you really going to discard this blade—discard me—right here and now...?!
No, that's not it—! Don't always assume the worst!
But seriously, if I really did say I wanted to buy a new blade—what would you do, Chitose?
In that case... I would settle it with a test of blades! I must see for myself which blade is truly worthy of serving you, my ==SEX11==...
Ugh, it's my fault for not communicating clearly. No wonder she got the wrong idea...
Sorry. Saying I wanted to try a different approach to achieve Oneness was just an excuse.
To be honest, I just wanted to buy you a gift.
Remember when you gave me that sageo before? I still haven't given you anything in return.
It's only proper to give you something in return, right? So it's not about guessing what I want to buy. I want you to pick out something you'd like for yourself.
Without hesitation, she points to a medium-sized whetstone.
A whetstone? Are you sure that's all you want? They have plenty of other blade accessories to choose from, you know.
I'm not just being polite—if I had this whetstone...
It means I could ask my ==SEX11== to take care of me in person, whenever I need. For a blade, it is the ultimate bliss...
She really picked a whetstone... Surprising for sure.
But if that's what she wants, then so be it. I did say she could choose for herself, after all.
Alright, alright! I don't really get it, but … if that's what you want, I'll use this to take care of you next time!
With the whetstone bought, Chitose and I leave the blacksmith's shop together, both of us satisfied.
